format: awesomecv-typst

  - _author-industry.yml
brand:
  typography:
    fonts:
      - family: Roboto
        source: google
        weight: [100, 400, 700]
      - family: Source Sans 3
        source: google
        weight: [100, 400, 700]
        style: [normal, italic]
    base: Source Sans 3
  color:
    primary: "#1A4E8A"
    link: "#7B3F5E"
  defaults:
    awesomecv-typst:
      font-header: Roboto
---

```{r}
source("../R/cv_helpers.R")
d <- cv_load()
v <- "industry"
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv_heading("Summary", "typst")
cv_print_text(d, v, c("intro_industry", "intro"))

cv_print_section(d, v, "industry_positions", "typst", "Industry Experience",
                 aside = "industry_experience_aside")
cv_print_section(d, v, "research_positions", "typst", "Research Experience")
cv_print_section(d, v, "education", "typst", "Education")
cv_print_section(d, v, c("reports", "academic_articles", "working_papers"), "typst",
                 "Selected Publications and Reports", aside = "publications_aside")
cv_print_skills(d, "typst")
```
